mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may inhibit atorvastatin metabolism via CYP3A4, potentially increasing statin levels and myopathy risk; additionally, statins can theoretically potentiate MAOI effects on cardiovascular dynamics.
action: Monitor for statin-related myalgia, elevated CK levels, and serotonergic effects; consider alternative antidepressant or lower atorvastatin dose with LFTs and CK monitoring.
